## TICKET R-LC-1

**Spec requirement IDs**: B4 / DW-C39-05b
**Title**: ApplyFeatureFlags inside Dispatcher.InvokeAsync lambda in RefreshRuleRows()
**File**: `src/PropTraderTools/TradeCopierWindow.cs`
**Change type**: Modify — add 1 line inside existing lambda
**NT8 sync**: REQUIRED

---

### Problem Statement

`OnLoaded()` calls `RefreshRuleRows()` at line ~150, then calls `ApplyFeatureFlags(CopyEngine.Instance.Flags)` at line 153 synchronously. `RefreshRuleRows()` queues its row-rebuild via `Dispatcher.InvokeAsync` (asynchronous). The line-153 call fires BEFORE the lambda runs. When persisted rules exist, rule rows are rebuilt AFTER flags have been applied — leaving Arm BE and Tighten buttons enabled for Starter-tier users.

---

### Exact Change

**Before** (lines 161–174):

```csharp
private void RefreshRuleRows()
{
    var instruments = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
    foreach (var instr in CopyEngine.Instance.GetRuleInstruments())
        instruments.Add(instr);
    if (instruments.Count == 0)
        return;
    Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
    {
        _rulesPanel.Children.Clear();
        foreach (var instr in instruments)
            _rulesPanel.Children.Add(BuildRuleRow(instr));
    });
}
```

**After** (1 line added inside the lambda — no other changes):

```csharp
private void RefreshRuleRows()
{
    var instruments = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
    foreach (var instr in CopyEngine.Instance.GetRuleInstruments())
        instruments.Add(instr);
    if (instruments.Count == 0)
        return;
    Dispatcher.InvokeAsync(() =>
    {
        _rulesPanel.Children.Clear();
        foreach (var instr in instruments)
            _rulesPanel.Children.Add(BuildRuleRow(instr));
        ApplyFeatureFlags(CopyEngine.Instance.Flags); // DW-C39-05b: apply flags after rows are built
    });
}
```

---

### Line 153 Retention — MANDATORY

The existing `ApplyFeatureFlags(CopyEngine.Instance.Flags)` call at line 153 (inside `OnLoaded`, OUTSIDE `RefreshRuleRows`) **MUST NOT be removed**.

It handles the code path where `instruments.Count == 0`: `RefreshRuleRows()` returns early, the `Dispatcher.InvokeAsync` lambda never fires, and the default MES row already in the DOM still needs flags applied.

| Path | instruments.Count | Line 153 call | Lambda call |
|------|-------------------|---------------|-------------|
| No saved rules | 0 | Applies to default MES row (needed) | Never fires |
| Saved rules exist | > 0 | Runs before rows rebuilt (idempotent) | Runs after rebuild (correct) |

`ApplyFeatureFlags` is a pure setter — idempotent. Two calls on the saved-rules path are intentional and harmless.

## TICKET R-LC-2

**Spec requirement IDs**: B5 / DW-C39-20
**Title**: Last-panel pending BE slots cleanup on close
**Files**:
1. `src/PropTraderTools/TradeCopierAddOn.cs` — add `IsPanelsEmpty()` helper
2. `src/PropTraderTools/CopyEngine.cs` — add `ClearAllPendingBeSlots()` method
3. `src/PropTraderTools/TradeCopierPanel.cs` — add guard in `Detach()`

**NT8 sync**: REQUIRED (all 3 files)

---

### Problem Statement

`DW-C38-03` fixed `Detach()` to disarm only the current panel's own leader account pending BE slot via `_engine.DisarmPendingBe(_leaderAccount)`. When BE ALL arms multiple accounts and the LAST panel closes, remaining slots for the other accounts are never cleared. Those `AccountItemUpdate` event watchers stay subscribed permanently — a memory and event-handler leak.

**Root cause sequence**:
1. `TradeCopierAddOn.OnWindowDestroyed` (line 108): `_panels.TryRemove(chart, out panel)` — atomically removes this panel.
2. `panel.Detach()` is then called.
3. At this point, if this was the last panel, `_panels` is **already empty** before `Detach()` executes.
4. `CopyEngine._pendingBeSlots` is a `ConcurrentDictionary<string, PendingBeSlot>` that persists all armed slots beyond the per-panel disarm.

---

### CHANGE 1 — TradeCopierAddOn.cs: Add IsPanelsEmpty()

**Method signature**:
```csharp
// DW-C39-20: Returns true when all panels have been detached (last-panel-close guard).
// Called by TradeCopierPanel.Detach(). CYC=1. JS-021: no lock.
// ConcurrentDictionary.IsEmpty is an atomic lock-free read.
// Mirrors IsPendingSlotsEmpty() pattern in CopyEngine (line 5764).
internal static bool IsPanelsEmpty() => _panels.IsEmpty;
```

**Location**: After the `_panels` field declaration (~line 41), grouped with other internal static helpers. Search for `_clickHandlers` and `_keyHandlers` field declarations; insert after the final field in that group (approximately line 53) as a standalone internal static helper.

**Before** (field area, no helper exists):
```csharp
// (only field declarations — no IsPanelsEmpty method present)
```

**After** (new method added):
```csharp
// DW-C39-20: Returns true when all panels have been detached (last-panel-close guard).
// Called by TradeCopierPanel.Detach(). CYC=1. JS-021: no lock.
// ConcurrentDictionary.IsEmpty is an atomic lock-free read.
// Mirrors IsPendingSlotsEmpty() pattern in CopyEngine (line 5764).

```

### CHANGE 2 — CopyEngine.cs: Add ClearAllPendingBeSlots()

**Method signature and full body**:
```csharp
// DW-C39-20: Clear all pending BE slots when last panel closes.
// Unsubscribes AccountItemUpdate handlers first to prevent orphan event handlers.
// Called from TradeCopierPanel.Detach() when TradeCopierAddOn.IsPanelsEmpty() is true.
// JS-021: no lock -- ConcurrentDictionary enumeration and Clear() are thread-safe.
// CYC=3: base(1) + foreach(1) + null guard(1).
internal void ClearAllPendingBeSlots()
{
    foreach (var kvp in _pendingBeSlots)
    {
        if (kvp.Value.Account != null)
            kvp.Value.Account.AccountItemUpdate -= OnPendingBeAccountUpdate;
    }
    _pendingBeSlots.Clear();
}
```

**Location**: After `IsPendingSlotsEmpty()` at line 5764.

**Before** (at line 5764):
```csharp
internal bool IsPendingSlotsEmpty() => _pendingBeSlots.IsEmpty;
// (next method or closing brace follows)
```

**After** (new method appended immediately after):
```csharp
internal bool IsPendingSlotsEmpty() => _pendingBeSlots.IsEmpty;

// DW-C39-20: Clear all pending BE slots when last panel closes.
// Unsubscribes AccountItemUpdate handlers first to prevent orphan event handlers.
// Called from TradeCopierPanel.Detach() when TradeCopierAddOn.IsPanelsEmpty() is true.
// JS-021: no lock -- ConcurrentDictionary enumeration and Clear() are thread-safe.
// CYC=3: base(1) + foreach(1) + null guard(1).
internal void ClearAllPendingBeSlots()
{
    foreach (var kvp in _pendingBeSlots)
    {
        if (kvp.Value.Account != null)
            kvp.Value.Account.AccountItemUpdate -= OnPendingBeAccountUpdate;
    }
    _pendingBeSlots.Clear();
}
```

**Design notes**:
- Event unsubscription (`-= OnPendingBeAccountUpdate`) is inside the `foreach` loop, BEFORE `_pendingBeSlots.Clear()`. This prevents orphan handlers that would fire after the slot is removed.
- CYC=3: base 1 + foreach branch 1 + null guard branch 1. Well within ≤8.
- `ConcurrentDictionary.Clear()` is safe on an empty dict (no-op). Concurrent-close edge case is safe.

---

### CHANGE 3 — TradeCopierPanel.cs: Guard in Detach()

**Location**: After `_engine.DisarmPendingBe(_leaderAccount);` at line 591, before the `// B32: DisarmTrailBe removed` comment.

**Before** (line 591–592):
```csharp
_engine.DisarmPendingBe(_leaderAccount);
// B32: DisarmTrailBe removed -- PTT no longer runs trail after BE (DW-B32-05).
```

**After** (3 lines inserted between those two lines):
```csharp
_engine.DisarmPendingBe(_leaderAccount);
// DW-C39-20: last-panel-close guard -- clear remaining global pending BE slots.
// TradeCopierAddOn removed this panel from _panels before calling Detach().
// If _panels is now empty, this was the last panel; clear all remaining slots.
if (TradeCopierAddOn.IsPanelsEmpty())
    _engine.ClearAllPendingBeSlots();
// B32: DisarmTrailBe removed -- PTT no longer runs trail after BE (DW-B32-05).
```

---

### JS Rule Constraints

| Rule ID | Rule | Application | Compliance |
|---------|------|-------------|-----------|
| JS-021 | No `lock()` | `ConcurrentDictionary.IsEmpty`, `.Clear()`, and foreach enumeration are all lock-free; NT8 event unsubscription (`-=`) is thread-safe from any thread | PASS |
| JS-033 | No `async void` | All new methods are `internal void` / `internal static bool` / `internal bool` — no async | PASS |
| JS-001 | No `throw` in hot path | No exceptions thrown in any new code | PASS |
| JS-002 | No `return null` | `ClearAllPendingBeSlots` is `void`; `IsPanelsEmpty` returns `bool`; neither returns null | PASS |
| JS-025 | Lock-free data structures | `ConcurrentDictionary` used throughout; no substitution with lock-protected collections | PASS |
| ASCII-only | Identifiers and strings | All identifiers and comment text are ASCII-only | PASS |

---

### Threading Model

| Call site | Thread | Thread-safe? |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| `OnWindowDestroyed` → `_panels.TryRemove` | NT8 event thread | Yes — `ConcurrentDictionary.TryRemove` is atomic |
| `panel.Detach()` | NT8 event thread | Yes — existing pattern |
| `IsPanelsEmpty()` | NT8 event thread | Yes — `ConcurrentDictionary.IsEmpty` is lock-free |
| `ClearAllPendingBeSlots()` | NT8 event thread | Yes — `ConcurrentDictionary.Clear()` is lock-free |
| `AccountItemUpdate -= ...` inside loop | NT8 event thread | Yes — NT8 event subscribe/unsubscribe is thread-safe |

No `Dispatcher.InvokeAsync` needed — R-LC-2 contains no UI work.

**Concurrent-close edge case**: If two panels close simultaneously, `_panels.TryRemove` is atomic. Only the panel that reduces `_panels` to zero will see `IsPanelsEmpty() == true`. `ClearAllPendingBeSlots()` safely handles an already-empty dict (no-op). CORRECT.
